A change in what people do, with a starting value and a target, held for one to two years. Three or fewer, set at the yearly direction review.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Goal](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [04 Goals and goal progress](/system/goals-and-goal-progress)
- **Owner:** executive steering group with the product manager
- **Links to:** [Roadmap](/templates/roadmap), [Initiative](/templates/initiative)

## Template

| Field | What goes here |
|---|---|
| Goal | By [timeframe], [user group] will [behavior change], measured by [metric], creating [community value]. |
| Short name | Seven words or fewer, for the progress table and the Now, Next, Later grid |
| Measure and source | Exactly how the metric is calculated and where the data comes from |
| Started | Baseline value, or "Baseline" and a plan to collect it in the first quarter |
| Target | The value we aim for by the end of the timeframe |
| Why it matters | One or two sentences tying it to the vision and strategy |

Progress is tracked in the roadmap's goal progress table: Started, Last, Current, Target and a progress circle, updated at quarterly planning: Grey (no data yet), Green (on pace), Yellow (behind) or Red (moving the wrong way), with the word written next to the color.

## DMV example

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Goal | By the end of fiscal year 2028, applicants for a standard new driver license will finish in a single interaction, measured by the share of applications needing more than one office visit (target 0%), ending the "bring documents and hope" experience. |
| Short name | Zero multi-trip experiences for standard licenses |
| Measure and source | Share of standard new license applications with more than one office visit, from appointment and counter records |
| Started | 85% |
| Target | 0% |
| Why it matters | The strategy's diagnosis: multiple trips happen because our systems can't verify eligibility in real time. This goal measures whether we fixed that. |
